business_problem: With its existing enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform nearing the end of its lifecycle, NSW Ports needed to find a suitable replacement – one that could not only maintain but improve the productivity of its finance team and the broader business.
solution_summary: NSW Ports, a Logistics organization in Australia, modernized this it operations automation workload with Dynamics 365 Finance, Power BI, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform. With its existing enterprise resource planning (ERP) platform nearing the end of its lifecycle, NSW Ports needed to find a suitable replacement – one that could not only maintain but improve the productivity of its finance team and the broader business. Dynamics 365 Finance standardizes finance, accounting, and operational processes on one business platform. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Microsoft Teams acts as the collaboration surface where users consume insights, copilots, and workflow updates. Sap move through Dynamics 365 Finance and related Microsoft services for orchestration and processing, with Microsoft Teams delivering the resulting workflow and insight to end users.
